import_notes: Use existing_entry_id first, otherwise exact lang/set_key/number and namespace. Never match only by name.
Merge cameo_dex edges into one physical identity; multiple subjects count once per printing.
Only normalized printings arrays are positive proposals; raw_variants are provenance, not blanket approval. Generated defaults and signed championship replicas are excluded.
Never clone cross-language releases or Japan numbers/dates into Korean cards.
No exact jumbo image asserted when image_scope is entry_reference.
Cameo scopes include recognizable depictions, costumes and plush backpacks.
Japanese/Korean historical jumbo coverage remains incomplete.
Japanese Detective Pikachu098 normal API claim is corrected to foil from Surugaya GN198733; official card44245, release2023-10-06.

recovery_comparison.note: The original secondary source index recovered all167 card identities. Matching against the full current English card/set index recovers additional exact localized matches, so recovered counts differ from the lost180-card snapshot. No false entries were added to match a target count.
